p.write_text('''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    counts = Counter(x for row in grid for x in row)
    colors = list(counts)
    bg = max(colors, key=counts.get)
    other = next((c for c in colors if c != bg), bg)
    return [[other if x == bg else 0 for x in row] for row in grid]
''')
import importlib.util
